:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}
#### Log-likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Derive the [log-likelihood](#def-loglik) of $\vy$
from @exr-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}

Starting from the [likelihood](#def-lik) in @thm-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group,
where $\sumof{\vy} \eqdef \sumin \outvar_\iobs$:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\llik(\prob; \vy)
&= \logf{\prob^{\sumof{\vy}} (1 - \prob)^{n - \sumof{\vy}}}
&& \text{(log of the likelihood)}\\
&= \logf{\prob^{\sumof{\vy}}} + \logf{(1 - \prob)^{n - \sumof{\vy}}}
&& \text{(log of a product)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \logf{\prob} + \paren{n - \sumof{\vy}} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a power)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \logf{\prob} + n \logf{1 - \prob} - \sumof{\vy} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(distribute $\logf{1 - \prob}$)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \logf{\prob} - \sumof{\vy} \logf{1 - \prob} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \paren{\logf{\prob} - \logf{1 - \prob}} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(collect the terms in $\sumof{\vy}$)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \logf{\frac{\prob}{1 - \prob}} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}\\
&= \sumof{\vy} \logodds + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\logodds \eqdef \logit(\prob)$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
